The claim 6474075400 served `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` by path mandate (SKILL.md); this review is served at that tier.

### ① Derived judgments

- Card 「Wanted」 1 (the exception, both conditions, p1/p2 only): new L30 「车道席自分诊:本车道卡挡自有在飞(认领卡/PR/落地/拆分链)且证据清楚,方可首触定 p1/p2。」 — (a) the four in-flight kinds the card names; (b) 「证据清楚」 spelled out on L31 as the card's three kinds (a named failing check/run, a reproduced measure, a pinned test, cited on the card); 「方可」 makes it an only-when: a card that does not block in-flight work, or sits outside the lane, cannot take this route (item 3's first two ⛔ as the contrapositive — accepted; the text says 本车道卡 and 方可). Holds.
- 「Wanted」 2 (same record, same review): L31 「记录照分诊格式贴卡,请分诊复审」 + L32 「行首 `Ruling-ref:` 引本例外裁决原话」 + L33 「…复审前席位定级有效」. Holds.
- 「Wanted」 3's remaining ⛔: L32 「⛔ 不改 `domain:*`、不定 p0(归 main-red)、不碰人工地板」 — the p0 pointer reads two lines up (L28–29, the main-red / queue-red p0 lines) and SKILL.md L35; the human floor is this file's L79–85. Holds.
- 「Wanted」 4 (SKILL.md): L170 「`domain:*`、队列与级别只由分诊落笔;两例外:sub-issue 承父卡域、main-red 锚卡,免审计评论。」 + L171 「无分诊审计评论 ⛔ 不得认领;车道席自分诊是队列与级别的第三例外,住 `triage-duties.md`。」 (118 / 118 B) — the absolute now names its third exception and its home; L34 红线 untouched as the card requires. The dropped clauses have homes on the head: 「无标签的卡 ⛔ 不得认领」 → SKILL.md L105 (open + 队列标签 + 无 assignee = 可派发) and execution-duties L7 (the lane read is by `domain:X` label) + L11 (无分诊审计评论即非候选); 「预贴标签只是建议」 → implied by 只由分诊落笔 itself and triage-duties L22 (same-minute labels read as untriaged) + L54 (`type` 立单者可预填、分诊校正 — the dev's "L52" is this line, off by two). Holds.
- Triage's seam (grade 6460243271): L33 「分诊每轮读上轮以来新贴的自分诊记录,逐条回复确认或改判;复审前席位定级有效。」 Holds.
- The four payments, each home read on the head: old L25 (下一 fire 断点续跑) → SKILL.md L68 + L93; old L31 (无主 p0 锚卡 … 只代派止血) → SKILL.md L35 红线 exception + landing-operations.md L82–84 约定③ (round report, then the standard claim line and a stop-bleed-only dev, 每轮一张) — a duplicate the same commit `3af6022e` landed; old L69 (生产者在哪) → the 责任三问 line (now L71: 谁的代码出险) + lanes/server.md L35 + lanes/hotcrm.md L30; old L71 merged verbatim into L24 (120 B: 先于旧卡重验 + 无逐卡豁免评论; 「总量」 and 「清得动就多清」 dropped — rhetoric, no rule lost). Genuine deletions, no re-wrap counted. Holds.

### ② Semver level

- None owed: `.claude/**` publishes nothing; `skip-changeset` correct; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial on the PR body, matching the claim; no `Skills-docs:` line owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Placement deviation accepted: the four lines sit after the main-red block (L28–29) rather than beside L75–78 / L11–16 as the order suggested — the p0 pointer then reads two lines up, which is the better reading; no move asked.
- Hypotheses 2 and 3 of the order were falsified by measurement (the seat's L69 home was wrong; the L171-only pointer did not fit) — recorded, the dev's measured route accepted.
- `check:pm-dispatch-gates` ran detached per its header; verdict line quoted, exit not captured — CI's Lint · PM dispatch-gates lane carries it; read off the head's check-runs in the ACCEPT.
- Out-of-scope finding (protocol drift): `lanes/skills.md` L22, `lanes/spec.md` L29, `lanes/ui.md` L8 still state the absolute — outside this card's two files; the seat files the follow-up card (blocked by this one) and names it in the ACCEPT.
- The commit trailer carries AGENTS.md's model-free pair, as os-dev.md directs — correct for this repo. Author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; `mcp_calls: 0`; `api_writes` 2 (both relay); draft, no flip by anyone.

### ④ Design judgment

- Against the maintainer's words (「影响你工作的,高优先级的,是否建议你直接分诊」 → 「照此执行,并立卡更新 skills」): the exception is narrow (blocks own in-flight work AND cited evidence), p1/p2 only, in triage's own record format with the ruling quoted, and triage re-reads every such record each round — the server lane's practice since 03:20Z is now the skill's text for every lane. Against the four-axis frame: focus (four lines, four paid, no gate, no label, no script), AI-error (the record format and `Ruling-ref:` make a self-triage recognisable and reviewable; the p0 and human-floor doors stay shut by name), long-run (one home for the rule, SKILL.md points at it; the charter drift is filed, not patched here). Holds. Residual: the three charter lines until the follow-up lands.
